SELECT * FROM `mskn_customer` WHERE `customer_id` = '89' AND `status` = '1'

            SELECT p.* , share_occupied.*, ps.*
            FROM `mskn_pms_project` p
            INNER JOIN `mskn_customer` c ON c.project_id = p.project_id
			INNER JOIN (SELECT project_id, SUM(ownership_units) AS occupied_total_units FROM `mskn_shareholders` GROUP BY project_id) AS `share_occupied` ON `share_occupied`.project_id = p.project_id
            INNER JOIN `mskn_project_status` ps ON ps.status_code = p.status
			WHERE c.customer_id = '89'
            AND p.is_deleted = 0
            AND p.is_active = 1
        

            SELECT p.* , ps.*
            FROM `mskn_pms_project` p
            INNER JOIN `mskn_customer` c ON c.project_id = p.project_id
			INNER JOIN `mskn_project_status` ps ON ps.status_code = p.status
			WHERE c.customer_id = '89'
            AND p.is_deleted = 0
            AND p.is_active = 1

SELECT * FROM `mskn_length_class` `mc` LEFT JOIN `mskn_length_class_description` `mcd` ON (`mc`.`length_class_id` = `mcd`.`length_class_id`) WHERE `mcd`.`language_id` = '1'

            SELECT s.*, 
                   p.name as project_name,
                   p.subscription_rate_per_apartment,
                   p.subscription_discount_type,
                   p.subscription_discount_value,
                   p.subscription_discount_reason
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription` s
            LEFT JOIN `mskn_pms_project` p ON s.project_id = p.project_id
            WHERE s.project_id = '20'
            ORDER BY s.subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        

            SELECT 
                CASE 
                    WHEN admin_override = 1 AND override_until > NOW() THEN 1
                    WHEN status = 'active' AND end_date > NOW() THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END as is_active
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        

            SELECT DATEDIFF(override_until, NOW()) as days
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            AND admin_override = 1
            AND override_until > NOW()
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        

            SELECT DATEDIFF(end_date, NOW()) as days
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            AND status = 'active'
            AND end_date > NOW()
            AND admin_override = 0
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1

                    WHEN status = 'active' AND end_date > NOW() THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END as is_active
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1

                    WHEN admin_override = 1 AND override_until > NOW() THEN 1
                    WHEN status = 'active' AND end_date > NOW() THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END as is_active
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1

            SELECT s.*, 
                   c.firstname, c.lastname, c.email, c.status as user_status,
                   c.date_added as registered_date,
                   (s.ownership_units / p.total_shares * 100) as ownership_percentage
            FROM `mskn_shareholders` s
            INNER JOIN `mskn_customer` c ON s.user_id = c.customer_id
            INNER JOIN `mskn_pms_project` p ON s.project_id = p.project_id
            WHERE s.project_id = '20'
            AND s.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY c.firstname ASC LIMIT 0,10

                    WHEN admin_override = 1 AND override_until > NOW() THEN 1
                    WHEN status = 'active' AND end_date > NOW() THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END as is_active
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1

                    WHEN status = 'active' AND end_date > NOW() THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END as is_active
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '20'
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1

            INNER JOIN `mskn_customer` c ON c.project_id = p.project_id
			INNER JOIN (SELECT project_id, SUM(ownership_units) AS occupied_total_units FROM `mskn_shareholders` GROUP BY project_id) AS `share_occupied` ON `share_occupied`.project_id = p.project_id
            INNER JOIN `mskn_project_status` ps ON ps.status_code = p.status

            AND p.is_active = 1

            SELECT SUM(total) AS total FROM (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total
                            FROM `mskn_expenses`
                            WHERE project_id = '19'
                            AND is_deleted = 0
                UNION ALL 
                SELECT SUM(total_amount) as total FROM `mskn_pms_expense_invoice` WHERE project_id = 19 AND is_deleted = 0
            ) AS total_expenses
        

            SELECT COUNT(*) as total
            FROM `mskn_expenses` e
            WHERE e.project_id = '19'
            AND e.is_deleted = 0
         AND DATE(e.expense_date) >= '2026-06-30' AND DATE(e.expense_date) <= '2026-07-30'

            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total
            FROM `mskn_pms_payment`
            WHERE project_id = '19'
            AND is_deleted = 0
        

            SELECT COUNT(*) as total
            FROM `mskn_pms_payment` p
            LEFT JOIN `mskn_shareholders` s ON p.shareholder_id = s.id
            LEFT JOIN `mskn_customer` c ON s.user_id = c.customer_id
            WHERE p.project_id = '19'
            AND p.is_deleted = 0
         AND DATE(p.payment_date) >= '2026-06-30' AND DATE(p.payment_date) <= '2026-07-30'

			SELECT 
				p.id,
				p.amount,
				p.payment_date,
				p.payment_method,
				p.reference_number,
				pp.name as phase_name,
				CONCAT(c.firstname, ' ', c.lastname) as shareholder_name,
				s.shareholder_code
			FROM `mskn_pms_payment` p
			LEFT JOIN `mskn_shareholders` s ON p.shareholder_id = s.id
			LEFT JOIN `mskn_customer` c ON s.user_id = c.customer_id
			LEFT JOIN `mskn_payment_phase` pp ON p.payment_phase_id = pp.phase_id
			WHERE p.project_id = '19'
			AND p.is_deleted = 0
			ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC, p.created_at DESC
			LIMIT 5
		

            SELECT i.*, 
                   s.supplier_name, s.supplier_code,
                   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `mskn_pms_expense_invoice_payment` ip WHERE ip.invoice_id = i.invoice_id AND ip.is_deleted = 0) as payment_count,
                   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM `mskn_pms_expense_invoice_payment` ip WHERE ip.invoice_id = i.invoice_id AND ip.is_deleted = 0) as paid_amount
            FROM `mskn_pms_expense_invoice` i
            LEFT JOIN `mskn_pms_supplier` s ON i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
            WHERE i.project_id = '19'
            AND i.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY i.invoice_date DESC

            SELECT 
                CASE 
                    WHEN admin_override = 1 AND override_until > NOW() THEN 1
                    WHEN status = 'active' AND end_date > NOW() THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END as is_active
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`

            LIMIT 1
        

            SELECT DATEDIFF(override_until, NOW()) as days
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '19'
            AND admin_override = 1
            AND override_until > NOW()
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        

            SELECT DATEDIFF(end_date, NOW()) as days
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription`
            WHERE project_id = '19'
            AND status = 'active'
            AND end_date > NOW()
            AND admin_override = 0
            ORDER BY subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        

            SELECT s.*, 
                   p.name as project_name,
                   p.subscription_rate_per_apartment,
                   p.subscription_discount_type,
                   p.subscription_discount_value,
                   p.subscription_discount_reason
            FROM `mskn_pms_project_subscription` s
            LEFT JOIN `mskn_pms_project` p ON s.project_id = p.project_id
            WHERE s.project_id = '19'
            ORDER BY s.subscription_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
